name: Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Make things reachable without open ports: creates Cloudflare tunnels itself via the API and forwards exactly the ports the RMM actually uses – dashboard, WebDAV, SFTP, RMM console (SSH), websites/web hosts, Docker containers as well as RDP/SSH/VNC to agents (via the RMM server or a node in the agent network). Selectable per route: open, RMM login (local or AD incl. 2FA) or one-time PIN by email; SSH/VNC also directly in the browser, everything also via cloudflared/WARP.
author: BYTERA
